name: trg_tb_people_after_insert
source:
/*!50003 CREATE*/ /*!50017 DEFINER=`root`@`localhost`*/ /*!50003 TRIGGER `trg_tb_people_after_insert` AFTER INSERT ON `tb_people` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
    INSERT INTO `tb_logs` (
        `table_name`,
        `table_operation`,
        `db_user`,
        `operation_date`,
        `table_description`,
        `operation_status`
    ) VALUES (
        'tb_people',
        'Create',
        COALESCE(NULLIF(CURRENT_ROLE(), 'NONE'), SESSION_USER()),
        NOW(),
        CONCAT('INSERT: person_ID=', NEW.person_ID, ', given_names=', NEW.given_names, ', family_names=', IFNULL(NEW.family_names, 'NULL'), ', user_ID=', IFNULL(NEW.user_ID, 'NULL')),
        1
    );
END */
explanation: Trigger asociado a la tabla indicada; efectos adicionales inferidos de las referencias en su cuerpo SQL.
